result.title: Reinforcement Learning with Hawkes-Structured Networks for Market Making
result.summary: Market making under realistic order-flow dynamics is challenging due to the clustered, self-exciting nature of order arrivals, which are naturally modeled by non-Markovian Hawkes processes. We propose a model-free reinforcement learning (RL) framework for market making with general Hawkes order-flow dynamics. We first establish non-asymptotic performance bounds that quantify the loss incurred by approximating the infinite-dimensional Hawkes state using a finite collection of exponentially weighted features. Guided by this analysis, we introduce the Hawkes-Structured Network (HSN), a novel neural architecture that encodes historical order flow through a learnable mixture-of-exponentials filter. HSN is trained end-to-end using model-free RL, jointly optimizing the feature representation and quoting policy directly from reward feedback. Experiments on single- and multi-asset market-making problems with mixture-of-exponentials, power-law, and regime-switching kernels demonstrate that HSN outperforms general-purpose neural architectures, achieving higher trading rewards while implicitly recovering the underlying order-flow intensities.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 Hawkes 自激励订单流下的做市问题，提出用可学习指数混合滤波器编码历史订单流的 HSN 网络，并以无模型 RL 端到端训练，同时给出有限维特征近似无限维状态的性能界。
AI.relevance_reason: 把无限维非马尔可夫历史压缩为有限可学习状态并量化近似损失的思路，可能为 LVR 中长轨迹状态的 latent 表示、缓存与近似误差评价提供借鉴线索，需核查其状态抽象是否可迁移。
